value.rationale: The cited first-passage model motivates mortality optimization at fixed recruitment-to-death ratio. In an extreme natural high-redundancy regime the result determines the previously unquantified fluctuating arrival clock and its logarithmic correction; the first informative mean comparison selects exactly one mortality coefficient and differentiates mean-time from long-time spectral-rate optimization. This is a motivated sharp asymptotic classification with explicit limits, not an arbitrary low-dimensional calculation.
